title: FRE-1072 Health Check
description: Not part of the FRE-533 rebuild inventory (AC-6) — a dedicated canary for AC-5(a): proves Grafana is serving real query results against a live datasource, not merely running. The panel below queries es-agent-logs for the fixture marker AC-5's own test writes and asserts the exact record comes back.

panels.title: Fixture Health Check
panels.description: AC-5(a): queries es-agent-logs for event_type:"fre1072_health_check" — the fixture AC-5's test injects — and must return exactly that record, not an empty placeholder and not a wrong-datasource false positive.
